steps.text: The second long journey through the vast void.
Awakening at the end of the journey—
Regret. Shame. Anger. Disorientation.
But even more so, confusion.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: You want me to stay? Then answer my question for It!

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: I came so far to find you.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: Did you know that those ants have dug through mountains and filled in rivers, calling the scars they leave upon the land 'cities?'

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: Is this frail and sick land still the cosmos that we had once lived and frolicked in?

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: Did you know that the marks They left before They died remain on this despicable city they call Yumen?

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: The ants have not repaired it for a thousand years, calling it part of the glorious journey towards civilization.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: This is the city that your fragment has sworn to protect?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: It is It. I am I.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: (Heaven's repressed anger)
The boat continues to sail.
The plants on the banks grow shorter, pressed down by the snow.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: Do you remember how our consciousnesses journeyed the sleepless void and became the first living beings here?

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: Do you remember how we watched the sun rise and set, giving order to time and objects, and Heaven and earth took shape?

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: Do you remember that eye which broke the heavens? We watched and clashed in the cosmos, the rivers turned red, the mountains leveled, the bodies piled up until they reached the clouds, becoming new mountains when they rotted away...

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: Such a magnificent thing a true war is!

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: (Heaven's repressed anger)
The boat continues to sail upon a river without end.
The snow grows thick. Each question echoes like an avalanche.
It is white up above and down below. The skies are so low that one only has to reach out to touch them.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: Why would one who has seen such an era care about the ants between its claws, and the dust that they stir up?

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: To deceive humanity, you meddled with cloud and rain, sent preposterous 'blessings' from the heavens, helped the so-called True Lung triumph. How utterly meaningless...

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: Why do you answer them again after a thousand years? Harass, provoke, hunt and kill your own kind?!

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: Compared to their ancestors, puny but brave, these ants are feeble, despicable, filthy. Why do you want to rule over them?!

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: Why do you want to become their god?!

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: (Heaven's repressed anger)

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: Since time immemorial, has our kind ever seen the shame that you have put yourself to?!
Answer me, my... my kin!

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: You're angry.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: In all these millennia of slumber, It has ever been like you are now...

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Swallowing the shame, chewing upon betrayal, seeking answers.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: That is why fragments like us were born.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: But we are not It.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I cannot answer your question.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I cannot understand your fury, just as you cannot understand mine.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: Fury?

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: You will stand for humanity? Here?

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: Draw the sword, and maybe you can.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I'm thinking how much you treasure this dimension.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Born in spring, prosper in summer, wilt in autumn, fade away in winter. Cut away the seasons, and hold it at one's bosom.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I could imagine how you hurriedly cut away this little pocket and took it with you when you fled Yan a thousand years ago.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: How you hid in a remote corner of the world, flipping through the pages again and again, licking your wounds before a snippet that will never fade.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Since when have the Feranmuts become so sentimental?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: How is it different from those feeble, despicable and filthy humans you speak of?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Eight thousand years of spring, eight thousand years of autumn. The snow never stops falling. This little corner will ever be itself.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: This is how you measure time...

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: How silly.
Days, months, years.
Winter turns to spring, then to winter again.
Time can be divided, no matter how long.
One mind, one will, one move. From equinox to solstice, to the next equinox.
Humanity has always been so, breaking down life into tiny constituents, and perceiving everything within those constituents.
The boat stops.
A firm fist connects with Ya's chest.
There is no extraneous motion, only the utmost simplicity.
The ice and snow melt into a single point on the river. Ya falls from the boat...
And hits the cold, hard ground.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: This is what you learned after you forsook Its power...

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: You are not It...
The man does not speak. He watches the 'human' before him, in its last throes.
All the living things of the world do not look so different on the brink of death.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: Why... haven't you killed me?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: No point. You can reshape your proxy's body at will.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Leave Yumen.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: We'll meet again.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: *cough*...

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: Sir, the initial damage report is in.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Casualties?

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: All civilians on the east side were safely evacuated to the west side.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: Half of the Imperial Astronomical Bureau Casters deployed at the inner city to deal with the secondary storm were injured. Also on scene were Mr. Lin of Lungmen and his daughter, Envoy Lin... Mr. Lin suffered serious injuries.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: H-He is being treated at the army hospital.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: All of Yumen owes Mr. Lin a great debt. Spare neither money nor manpower.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Damage to buildings?

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: The west side was unaffected. A number of buildings were damaged by the storm in the east and north sides.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: The east side took the brunt of the storm.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: Two of the Four Guardians were damaged beyond economical repair and have been detached by the Tianshi.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: Part of the foundation wall has been severely warped. Emergency repairs are in progress.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: About 60% of all city defenses have been damaged.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: The Tianshis' assessment?

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: Initial estimates are that it will take at least two months before Yumen can move again, even with full effort devoted to the repairs.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Two months...

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Slightly better than pre-Catastrophe estimates.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Here are my orders.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: The entire army will remain alert for potential after-storms.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Continue to assess damage and treat the injured. Erect emergency shelters to house the evacuated population.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: And the Shanhaizhong?

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: They attempted to cause chaos by attacking city defenses and harassing the people. Most have been brought to justice by the Patrol Battalion's prompt intervention, assisted by civilian volunteers.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: Only a few managed to escape through gaps in the damaged walls.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: ...I see.

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: However, we have not found the Shanhaizhong leader responsible for the assassination attempt at the barracks. Search efforts are underway.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: She did not show herself?

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Strange, given her ability...

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: What of the Grandmaster?

steps.name: Patrol Battalion Soldier
steps.text: The Grandmaster visited the Sword Forge. He has not been seen since.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Why did you give me this sword?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I want you to keep it safe... consider it a request.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: So this was the sword that all the fuss was about.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: What is it, anyway?
It is too many things.
An artifact holding one of the twelve fragments of the Sui, witness to a relationship of love and hate, an old antique sword.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: A keepsake for our next fight.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Just don't let anyone steal it again, or pawn it for money.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Right...

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Sounds important.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Well, if it's too much trouble...

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: I'm just thinking... we don't really know each other that well.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I know your name is Huai Tianpei. You have two wise friends, and a talented daughter.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: And you are the only one who has ever gotten the upper hand on me, even once.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: I know you're the only one I couldn't beat, in my forty years of training.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: I'll take the sword.

steps.name: Huai Tianpei
steps.text: I'll find you after I've trained for another forty years.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I'll be waiting.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Excuse me, doctor.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: How much does the man who worked at your clinic owe you? I'll pay it.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Nah, he worked that off ages ago.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: It was just a convenient excuse to take him in.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Better for him to be in here mending people's bones, than out there breaking them.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Thank you... for everything.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Are you his daughter?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Just found it hard to believe he had a daughter so polite and well-mannered. No offense, of course.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Still, it takes some getting used to, not having him around.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: How am I going to clean up all this sand by myself?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I-I'll help!

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Left without a word? Again?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Some men never change.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I'm not so anxious to find him this time around, though.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Looks like you've made your own plans.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I have my job at the agency, and school. And kung fu, of course.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: He'll get more than just a kick in the chin the next time I see him.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: Orders from above. We have our next mission. We'll go once we've rested and recovered.

steps.name: Restless Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Too bad Yumen survived the Catastrophe, while we took heavy casualties.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: (Sneers)
The letter burns in the masked man's hand, quickly turning to ash, making a tiny corner of gold even more conspicuous.
Paint from a special seal that only top imperial mandarins may use. Only five people have access to it.
The man rubs the seal in his hand, crushing it into tiny pieces that fade into the sand.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: Our mission was to cause a commotion that would catch the imperial court's attention. We still have a use for Yumen. It will not do to lose it.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: We move now.

steps.name: Restless Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: We're not waiting for Master? We could hardly have done this without her.

steps.name: Restless Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: It's the Di beast... Master is back!

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: Careful...

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: Who in Yumen could have injured you like this?!

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: A 'Man.'

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: What else did you hear?

steps.name: Di Beast
steps.text: (Eerie roar)

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: How long?

steps.name: Di Beast
steps.text: (Eerie roar)

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: Two months?

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: ...That's enough.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: I know where It is.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: What do you... what are you...?

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: Master, I'm afraid we must part here.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: Suit yourself.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: Just don't get in my way.
There is always an end to the path, no matter how long.
I have felt it since my awakening, growing ever clearer. What they call 'Mortality.'
The wounds from that hunt will never fully heal.
I hope you have awakened.
I have little time left. I have few kin left.
Let us settle this.
